figurative_meaning_en: To suddenly fall into trouble or a predicament
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে ব্যবসায় টাকা লাগিয়ে হঠাৎ পাঁকে পড়ল।
এই সিদ্ধান্ত নিলে তুমি নিশ্চয় পাঁকে পড়বে।
example_sentences_in_english: He suddenly fell into the mud by investing money in that business.
You'll surely get into trouble if you make this decision.
note: The idiom draws from rural imagery of slipping into muddy fields or ponds, symbolizing unexpected mishaps.
